name: Nord Süd Trail, Abschnitt Bergedorf - Fischbek
description_md:
The Nord Sud Trail, Abschnitt Bergedorf - Fischbek is a 49.0 km waymarked hiking route located in Germany. It features 279 m of ascent and 266 m of descent, requiring about 13 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

This hard route is signposted as NST and is part of the international waymarked hiking network. Nearby, the route passes Hamburg within 800 m, CARLS an der Elbphilharmonie within 1100 m, and the Miniatur Wunderland Restaurant within 1200 m. The difficulty of the trail is derived from distance and ascent.
